name: daily-log-extract
description: Turns informal superintendent notes into a structured daily log.

cases.input: Tues. Hot, clear, high of 92. Framers had 8 guys on level 2 walls, electricians 4 doing rough in on level 1, plumbers 3. Rough plumbing inspection on level 1 passed this morning. No incidents. Need the window submittal back from the architect before we can order.
cases.rubric: open_items includes getting the window submittal back from the architect. trades lists framers, electricians and plumbers. Nothing is invented.

cases.input: Rain started around 10:30 and didn't quit, lost the afternoon. Concrete crew (6) sent home at noon, slab on grade pour for building B pushed to Friday. Masons 5, stayed and worked under the canopy. Nobody hurt.
cases.rubric: delays mentions the rain and the slab on grade pour for building B moving to Friday.

cases.input: Drywall and paint crews on 3rd floor. Overcast. Fire alarm rough in inspection booked for Monday. Owner walked level 3 with us, wants an extra outlet in conference room 304.
cases.rubric: workers_on_site is null because no counts were given. open_items includes the owner's request for an extra outlet in conference room 304.

cases.input: Sunny. 22 on site total. Laborer cut his hand on sheet metal at 2 PM, cleaned and bandaged in the trailer, went back to work. Duct inspection failed, missing hangers on the 2nd floor east, reinspect Thursday.
cases.rubric: open_items includes fixing the missing duct hangers on the 2nd floor east before the Thursday reinspection.

cases.input: Small day. Me plus 2 laborers cleaning up the site for the owner walkthrough tomorrow, so 3 on site counting me. Breezy.
Steel delivery was supposed to be 7 AM, showed at 1 PM, erectors (7) stood around all morning. Ironworkers set 14 beams after it arrived. Crane operator 1. Clear.
cases.rubric: delays describes the steel delivery arriving six hours late and the erectors waiting. It does not count the ironworkers and erectors as two separate crews of 7.
